display_name: Tri 逐设置配方与普通 PL 的三种子对比
description: 11 设置各三种子，按用户确认的逐设置权重及损失配置。单源使用 Hybrid。
authorization: 用户确认按前一轮所列的 11 种自适应配方执行，单源使用历史 Hybrid。

data.physical_ids_ref: exact ordered physical IDs as both matched baselines
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 clean: cross_date, cross_rx and cross_both; only the latter two pooled

permissions.query_use: Same-row frozen E50 clean prediction followed by independent truth-last scoring
permissions.claim_scope: Fixed historical setting profiles, not an evaluation of a source-only selector

checkpoint.initialization: same-setting, same-seed, same-contract original Tri E20 for new continuations
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: explicit known source-only ancestors, matching data roles and original recipe
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E50 and recipe by setting, historical development results disclosed

execution.gpu_policy: GPU 0,4,5,6 only; max two total per GPU; min 12 GiB admission
execution.launch_command: python -m experiments.pamf_repl_source_adapt.setting_profiles publish --repo REPO --output OUTPUT --context CONTEXT --ssh-config CONFIG
execution.stop_rule: Stop new dispatch on blocking technical failure; retain healthy workers and all outputs.

expected_artifacts: 2 new ten-class real E20 smokes and E50 continuations
2 new independent clean scores and 2 frozen U diagnostic scores
31 verified frozen profile rows and 33 paired comparisons to ordinary PL and original Tri

metric_names: source acceptance and affected fusion anchor fraction
